title: A skeleton loading shimmer
summary: Grey placeholder shapes with a wide gradient whose background-position slides across forever.
explanation: A skeleton shows the shape of content that is still loading, so the page does not jump when it arrives. Each bar is a grey block with the same gradient: grey, a lighter band, grey.

background-size: 300% makes the gradient three times wider than the bar, so only a slice of it shows. The @keyframes rule slides background-position from 100% to 0%, which drags the light band across. linear infinite keeps it going at an even pace.
Every bar runs the same animation in sync, which reads as one sweep down the card. A reduced-motion rule stops it for people who asked for less movement; the grey shapes still work.
tryThis: Change 1.4s to 3s for a calmer shimmer.
Change background-size to 100%: the band no longer moves because there is nothing extra to slide.
